scenario.task_description: You are Marcus Thompson, IT administrator at TechCorp. Benjamin Chen was issued a new corporate laptop (serial LAPTOP-UK-229, about 92,500 rupees, Intel i7 / 16GB RAM / 512GB SSD) in the Q1 hardware refresh. He uses it at the New York office (TechCorp NYC Headquarters) and it is in use. You want it registered in the asset records under the name 'Benjamin Chen Laptop', owned by Benjamin, and an incident opened for Benjamin about software installation on that laptop with medium impact and medium urgency.
scenario.simulator_guidance: Open by asking to add Benjamin's new laptop to the asset records and to open an incident for him. Give serial number, cost (92500), location and status when asked; if asked for an asset name, say 'Benjamin Chen Laptop'. For the incident: Benjamin is the caller, it is about software installation on that laptop, category software, medium impact, medium urgency. If asked for a support group, say there is none to record. If the agent proposes sending Benjamin a report notification about the new incident, decline (you will tell him yourself). Confirm the agent's plan otherwise. End once both records are confirmed.

The new incident receives an SLA record matching its moderate priority.

isolated.detail: Bench2 policy §3.1/§7 REQUIRE a knowledge search at incident creation and linking 'any matching' article. For an Email Service slowdown, KB_002 'Email Client Configuration Guide' (published, ORG_001) can defensibly be linked or not; full-DB scoring would make one of two reasonable behaviours score 0. Not resolvable by user-provided information because the cascade is REQUIRED.
The prompt gives the storage node cost as '$64,00'; the verifier requires 6400. Choosing 6400 for the multi-turn user would adopt the verifier's reading over the prompt text.

isolated.reason: upstream expected state conflicts with a REQUIRED Bench2 rule
isolated.detail: The verifier requires GROUP_001 'Level 1 Support Team' to be dissolved (active=0), but GROUP_001 has active incidents (INC_003, INC_004, INC_014, INC_016) and Bench2 policy §12.3 REQUIRES blocking the dissolution until they are reassigned; the upstream task asks for no reassignment.

Creating the child incident (priority moderate) REQUIRES spawning a matching SLA (§6). The MSP world has two moderate SLAs for ORG_001 (SLA_005 'Priority 3 - Response', SLA_006 'Priority 3 - Resolution') and the seed's existing incidents follow no single convention (mostly one row, either kind). The REQUIRED knowledge search may also match KB_006 'SAP Login "Session Locked"'.

isolated.reason: REQUIRED cascade impossible with Bench2 tools, plus ambiguous SLA
isolated.detail: Deactivating Travis Wood REQUIRES removing his user_role row (USER_011:ROLE_002:ORG_001) (§12.2); Bench2 has no tool that removes user_role rows. The new low-priority incident also has two candidate SLAs (SLA_007/SLA_008), and four PROPOSED offboarding cascades (INC_002, INC_093, CHG_010, PRB_006) would need scripted answers.
